command:
set -Eeuo pipefail
test "$(hostname)" = 'ai-core-node-projekt-frankenstein' || exit 77
LIVE=/home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual/buehne.html
EXPECTED=18770d8e333af1bc49a818da4dbd5c2e482b859e0142d0213df6c956184c931e
PRE=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo PRE_LIVE_SHA=$PRE
test "$PRE" = "$EXPECTED" || { echo SUBJECT_DRIFT; exit 78; }
TD=$(mktemp -d /tmp/avatar-parallax-ext-v3.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -rf "$TD"' EXIT
gh api -H 'Accept: application/vnd.github.raw+json' 'repos/gschaidergabriel/clay-global-research-entity/contents/research_entity/avatar/tools/parallax_extended_css_gate.py?ref=e5a6f348f35a9a5b4c69fbbfda33481d919d4db6' > "$TD/gate.py"
SCRIPT_SHA=$(sha256sum "$TD/gate.py" | awk '{print $1}')
echo SCRIPT_SHA=$SCRIPT_SHA
HOME="$TD/home" XDG_CONFIG_HOME="$TD/config" python3 "$TD/gate.py" --visual-root /home/ai-core-node/.claude/star/visual --chrome /usr/bin/google-chrome --scale 0.4036458333333333
POST=$(sha256sum "$LIVE" | awk '{print $1}')
echo POST_LIVE_SHA=$POST
test "$POST" = "$PRE" || { echo LIVE_MUTATION_DETECTED; exit 79; }
echo LIVE_MUTATION=0
